segments.name: Insurance
segments.description: Lemonade provides digital, AI-powered renters, homeowners, car, pet and life insurance to consumers in the United States and Europe.
segments.evidence: A brief chat with our bot, AI Maya, is all it takes to get covered with renters, homeowners, pet, car or life insurance, and we expect to offer a similar experience for other insurance products over time.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay recurring subscription-style insurance premiums, with volatility reduced through reinsurance and additional income from commissions on premiums placed with third-party insurers.
revenueModel.evidence: Strong retention rates and a subscription-based model create highly-recurring and naturally-growing revenue streams, and provide visibility into our topline results.
